payload.artist_html: Ya-Lei Yin, Rui Pei​, Chang-Fu Zhou
payload.description_html:
Skull and mandibles of Sinovenator PMOL-AD00102 in left lateral view.

(A) photograph; (B) CT-rendered image. Study sites: an, angular; ax, axis; co, coronoid; cp, cultriform process; cr, cervical ribs; d, dentary; e, epipterygoid; f, frontal; j, jugal; l, lacrimal; ls, laterosphenoid; m, maxilla; n, nasal; p, parietal; pl, palatine; po, postorbital; pop, paroccipital process; pra, prearticular; q, quadrate; qj, quadratojugal; sd, supradentary; sp, splenial; sq, squamosal; su, surangular; v, vomer.
